STEP-02: removes date fragments flags . STEP-03: normalizes conjunctions, prepositions, separators. STEP-04: splits multi-title strings individual rows. title: titleclassifier
text: sections provide workflow summary Title Classifier process: Standardize raw data: Start cleaning Part VII table: rename fields, fix titles, convert compensation hours numeric values, ensure checkboxes consistent. Remove dates titles: Strip start/end dates, year ranges, calendar references sometimes appear titles. Create flag know titles contained dates. Normalize conjunctions separators: Clean words like , , , commas, slashes, ampersands. Make sure used consistently later splitting won’t misinterpret . Split multi-title strings: Break apart rows single individual’s Title field contains multiple roles (e.g., “President & Treasurer”). role gets row. Harmonize spelling abbreviations: Standardize variations “VP”, “Vice Pres.”, “V.P.” → “VICE PRESIDENT”. Apply large dictionary fixes common nonprofit role terms. Detect flag status qualifiers: Identify titles qualifiers like FORMER, INTERIM, FOUNDER, EX OFFICIO. Remove standardize , add parallel indicator flags. Standardize titles canonical forms: Use curated crosswalk map raw titles controlled vocabulary. Apply logic resolve tricky executive roles (e.g., PRESIDENT = CEO). Categorize roles add features: Assign standardized title categories (CEO, C-level, Board, Manager, Specialist, etc.). Compute organizational summaries like counts leaders, pay ranks, hours distributions. short: workflow takes raw nonprofit officer/employee titles IRS Form 990 data, cleans step step, produces analysis-ready dataset role standardized, categorized, enriched organizational metrics.

title: titleclassifier
